LESSON: LISTENING COMPREHENSION

Grade: PP2
Subject: LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.2: LISTENING comprehension

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on LISTENING comprehension. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What makes listening school. comprehension fun?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. Answer questions to a story and be encouraged to answer correctly after a listening questions. 2.
2. Sing songs with actions simple riddles. opportunities require in and out of school. •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: LISTENING COMPREHENSION
This lesson teaches LISTENING comprehension for PP2 LANGUAGE ACTIVITIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. Answer questions to a story and be encouraged to answer correctly after a listening questions. 2.
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. Sing songs with actions simple riddles. opportunities require in and out of school. •
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe LISTENING comprehension using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about LISTENING comprehension above.
2. Explain LISTENING comprehension to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand LISTENING comprehension.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about LISTENING comprehension with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is LISTENING comprehension important for a PP2 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What makes listening school. comprehension fun?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Answer questions to a story and be encouraged to answer correctly after a listening questions. 2.
2. Sing songs with actions simple riddles. opportunities require in and out of school. •

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
